SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN reconciliation_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN reconciliation_status = 'IN_TRANSIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inTransitCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN reconciliation_status = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS canceledCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN reconciliation_status = 'MATCHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS matchedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN reconciliation_status = 'ANOMALY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS anomalyCount FROM ( SELECT o.id, CASE
WHEN o.erp_status = 'READY_TO_SHIP' THEN 'PENDING'
WHEN o.erp_status IN ('SHIPPED', 'ARRIVED_AT_PLATFORM_WAREHOUSE') THEN 'IN_TRANSIT'
WHEN o.erp_status = 'CANCELED' THEN 'CANCELED'
WHEN o.erp_status = 'DELIVERED' AND fr.sale_count > 0 THEN 'MATCHED'
WHEN o.erp_status = 'RETURNED' AND fr.record_count > 0 THEN 'MATCHED'
ELSE 'ANOMALY' END AS reconciliation_status FROM erp_order o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.assembly_id, r.shop_id, COUNT(*) AS record_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.supplier_oper_name IN ('销售', '合规销售', 'Продажа') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sale_count FROM wb_report_detail r WHERE r.assembly_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assembly_id != '' AND r.period_type = #{qo.periodType} GROUP BY r.assembly_id, r.shop_id ) fr ON fr.assembly_id = o.platform_order_id AND fr.shop_id = o.shop_id WHERE o.platform = 'wildberries'
) AS order_status
WHERE reconciliation_status IN
#{status}

SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.platform, o.platform_order_id AS platformOrderId, o.raw_json ->> '$.rid' AS rid, o.shop_id AS shopId, s.name AS shopName, o.fulfillment_type AS fulfillmentType, o.erp_status AS erpStatus, o.platform_status AS platformStatus, o.platform_substatus AS platformSubstatus, o.platform_created_at_moscow AS orderTimeMoscow, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.total_amount_rub AS totalAmountRub, o.currency_code AS currencyCode, o.converted_amount AS convertedAmount, o.converted_currency_code AS convertedCurrencyCode,
CASE
WHEN o.erp_status = 'READY_TO_SHIP' THEN 'PENDING'
WHEN o.erp_status IN ('SHIPPED', 'ARRIVED_AT_PLATFORM_WAREHOUSE') THEN 'IN_TRANSIT'
WHEN o.erp_status = 'CANCELED' THEN 'CANCELED'
WHEN o.erp_status = 'DELIVERED' AND fr.sale_count > 0 THEN 'MATCHED'
WHEN o.erp_status = 'RETURNED' AND fr.record_count > 0 THEN 'MATCHED'
ELSE 'ANOMALY' END AS reconciliationStatus,
COALESCE(fr.record_count, 0) AS financialRecordCount, COALESCE(fr.sale_amount, 0) AS saleAmount, COALESCE(fr.actual_income, 0) AS actualIncome, fr.currency_name AS financialCurrencyName FROM erp_order o LEFT JOIN shop s ON s.id = o.shop_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.assembly_id, r.shop_id, COUNT(*) AS record_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.supplier_oper_name IN ('销售', '合规销售', 'Продажа') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sale_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.supplier_oper_name IN ('销售', '合规销售', 'Продажа') THEN COALESCE(r.ppvz_for_pay, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sale_amount,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.supplier_oper_name IN ('销售', '合规销售', 'Продажа') THEN COALESCE(r.ppvz_for_pay, 0) WHEN r.supplier_oper_name IN ('退货', 'Возврат', '销售冲销') THEN -COALESCE(r.ppvz_for_pay, 0) ELSE 0 END ) - SUM(COALESCE(r.penalty, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(r.deduction, 0)) AS actual_income, MAX(r.currency_name) AS currency_name FROM wb_report_detail r WHERE r.assembly_id IS NOT NULL AND r.assembly_id != '' AND r.period_type = #{qo.periodType} GROUP BY r.assembly_id, r.shop_id ) fr ON fr.assembly_id = o.platform_order_id AND fr.shop_id = o.shop_id WHERE o.platform = 'wildberries'
AND (
(o.erp_status = 'READY_TO_SHIP')
(o.erp_status IN ('SHIPPED', 'ARRIVED_AT_PLATFORM_WAREHOUSE'))
(o.erp_status = 'CANCELED')
((o.erp_status = 'DELIVERED' AND fr.sale_count > 0) OR (o.erp_status = 'RETURNED' AND fr.record_count > 0))
NOT ( o.erp_status = 'READY_TO_SHIP' OR o.erp_status IN ('SHIPPED', 'ARRIVED_AT_PLATFORM_WAREHOUSE') OR o.erp_status = 'CANCELED' OR (o.erp_status = 'DELIVERED' AND COALESCE(fr.sale_count, 0) > 0) OR (o.erp_status = 'RETURNED' AND COALESCE(fr.record_count, 0) > 0) )
(1 = 0)
)
ORDER BY o.platform_created_at_moscow DESC
